FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: What is the best app for self-guided audio tours?
FAQ.a1: TUGGI is a self-guided audio travel guide for iOS and Android. It plays audio stories about the places around you automatically, triggered by GPS — hands-free and screen-off — while you drive, walk, or cycle. It works offline, supports {contentLanguages} languages with closed captions, and is free to start.
FAQ.q2: Is there a free audio travel guide app?
FAQ.a2: Yes. TUGGI is free to download and starts with stories every day. To listen without a daily limit, a Tuggi Pass gives you 10, 25 or 45 hours of use, with a one-time payment. The hours never expire, and you'll see the price in the App Store or Google Play.
FAQ.q3: What's a good travel app for a road trip?
FAQ.a3: TUGGI was built for road trips: it runs alongside your navigation and music and narrates the landmarks, towns, and history you pass automatically — no screen, no searching. Download your route in advance to use it offline with no roaming charges.
FAQ.q4: Can I explore a city without a tour guide?
FAQ.a4: Yes. TUGGI acts as a self-guided audio guide, so you can explore at your own pace without booking a human guide or a fixed tour. Stories play automatically as you reach each point of interest, on foot or by car.
FAQ.q5: Does TUGGI work offline and in my language?
FAQ.a5: Yes. Download a route in advance and listen with no signal and no roaming charges. TUGGI offers audio in {contentLanguages} languages with synchronized closed captions for deaf and hard-of-hearing travelers.
FAQ.q6: How is TUGGI different from Google Maps or a human guide?
FAQ.a6: TUGGI isn't a navigation app and doesn't replace your GPS — it runs alongside it and adds self-guided audio storytelling about the places you pass. Unlike a human guide, it's available 24/7, in multiple languages, hands-free, and free to start.
FAQ.a7: For anyone who likes to explore on the move: tourists, curious locals, cyclists, walkers, passengers on a bus, train or van, and drivers too. It works on a road trip, on a walking city tour, on a bike or scooter ride, and on public transport. Because the audio is triggered by GPS and runs offline, the experience is the same in any mode of transport.

Context.title: What is TUGGI
Context.p1: TUGGI is a self-guided audio travel guide for iPhone and Android. It uses GPS to recognize the places you pass and tells the story of each one out loud, at the right moment, without you searching for anything on the screen. It works however you travel: on foot, by bike, by car, by bus or on the metro.
Context.p2: Stories start on their own as you get close to a point of interest. Because everything works offline, you download a city before you leave and listen with no internet and no roaming data. And since every story comes with synchronized captions, deaf and hard-of-hearing travelers follow along on screen.
Context.p3: TUGGI does not replace your navigation app: it runs alongside it, without getting in the way of your map or your music, and simply adds the cultural narration of the route. Start free, pick from {contentLanguages} languages, and turn any trip into a journey with a story.

FAQ.title: The questions we hear most
FAQ.a1: Appearing on Tuggi costs nothing: you sign up, we approve you, you display the QR Code and, after we assess it, your place is published, found and read by every traveller. Tuggi also takes no cut of your sales, and you pay for nobody's access. The one who pays for Tuggi is the traveller. There is one paid part of the partnership, outside that list, and we go over it with you.
FAQ.q2: Do I have to change anything in how I work?
FAQ.a2: Two things. You put the QR Code where the traveller is already looking — on the menu, at the front desk, on the counter, on the back of the seat — and you tell us the story of your place, once. Beyond that, the partnership requires no integration with your system, no equipment and no software for your staff to operate.
FAQ.q3: Will my place really get into Tuggi?
FAQ.a3: It is not automatic, and we would rather say so now. Once the partnership is approved, our team assesses your place. What gets in is permanent, open to the public and has a story of its own to tell. It does not have to be famous or old. If something is missing, we tell you what it was, and you can fix it and put it forward again.
FAQ.q4: And if my place does not get in?
FAQ.a4: You are still a partner. Your QR Code, the traveller attributed to you and your revenue share do not depend on it. Nothing you already have goes away.
FAQ.q5: What if my guest does not speak English?
FAQ.a5: Tuggi speaks {contentLanguages} languages to the traveller. When your place is published, it is read in the language of whoever arrives. And whoever has the guide on hears it in that same language. We produce the narration the moment someone asks for it in that language.
FAQ.q6: What do I earn from this?
FAQ.a6: The traveller downloads Tuggi through your QR Code and is attributed to you. From then on, every purchase they make counts towards your revenue share. The percentage is set in a commercial agreement, and that is what we talk about when you leave your details below.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: TUGGI Technologies values your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, protect, and handle your data, in strict compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Brazil) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR - European Union).
Privacy.s1Intro: For TUGGI to function as your cultural copilot, we collect the information below. The list does not stop at the app. It also covers the data of people who approach Tuggi about a partnership, even if they have never had an account.
Privacy.s1Item1: Account and Authentication Data: When creating an account via email or partner providers (Google, Apple, Facebook), we receive basic profile data (Name, Email, and user ID generated by our secure Supabase infrastructure).
Privacy.s1Item2: Geolocation Data (GPS): TUGGI requires real-time location access (including in the background) to trigger audio exactly when you cross a Point of Interest (POI).
Privacy.s1Item3: Usage and Telemetry Data: We collect information about application interactions, such as which audios were played, selected languages, and system stability metrics.
Privacy.s1Item4: Business Contact Details: When you leave your details in the form on the partnerships page of this site, we store what you typed there. That is your name, your business name, the type of business and the channel you chose, WhatsApp number or email. We also store the language the page was in. The approximate city comes from your connection, and alongside your details we store that city, not the IP address. We use these details for one purpose only, which is to talk to you about the partnership, by phone call or by message. That means at most 4 contact attempts, within 14 calendar days of your submission. The cycle ends at whichever comes first, and after it we no longer use your details for this. To pick it up again, just send the form once more. We never use these details for newsletters, broadcast lists or marketing campaigns. You can ask us to remove them whenever you want, and section 5 explains how.
Privacy.s1Item5: Partnership Proposal Data: There is a partnership proposal form on this site, open to any establishment that wants to propose a partnership. Whoever fills it in sends us two things. One is the establishment, with its trading name and registered company name, CNPJ, category, full address with postcode, district, city and state, opening hours, website and Instagram. The other is the person who answers for the establishment, with name, role, email and phone, and those are one person's data. For a Brazilian MEI or sole trader, the registered company name carries the owner's own name, and the address may be their home address, so we treat that whole form as personal data. We use what arrives there for five things: assessing the proposal, talking to the person about this partnership, drawing up the contract and sending it for signature to the email given, limiting abuse on the page, which anyone can open, and measuring where the form gets in the way. To limit abuse we count how many proposals come from each connection. For that count we store a code calculated from the IP address, and not the address. That code is not anonymous, because the same connection always produces the same code. To measure where the form gets in the way we count how many people open each step and at which step they stop. For that count we store neither your name, nor your connection address, nor anything you wrote. You can ask us to remove this data, and section 5 explains how.
Privacy.s1Item6: The Story of the Place: In that same form we ask up to four questions about the history of the place, and the answers are free text. They are not internal material and they are not confidential. They are the raw material for the text the app may narrate to a traveller, rewritten by us and translated into the languages of the app. So write there only what you accept seeing published, including the name of anyone you mention.
Privacy.s1Item7: Record of Contract Acceptance: When someone accepts the partnership contract on screen, we store the record of that act. It holds the name and role of the person who accepted, the email we sent the link to, the date and time from our server, the connection's IP address, the identification the browser declares, the code of the document shown and the template version. Here the IP address is stored as it is, and not turned into a code, because the purpose is a different one. This record serves one purpose only, which is to prove who accepted the contract, what they accepted, when and from where. It feeds no metric, it is not used for contact, and it is kept as proof of the contract.
Privacy.s1Item8: Visit to a Partner Page: When you reach a partner page on this site, through a QR code or through a link of theirs, we record that visit. If you are browsing from outside Brazil and the United States, that record is only created after you accept cookies on this site. Until you accept, we store nothing of that visit and write no cookie on your device. We store your connection's IP address, the identification the browser declares, the browser language and the device time zone. We also store which partner you visited and the time. Alongside that we write a cookie of this site, named tuggi_attr, which lasts 30 days and holds the partner identifier, the identifier of that visit and the date. This record serves one purpose only, which is to know which partner brought you to the app, because that is how we pay that partner. It feeds no advertising and it is not used for contact. The IP address and the browser identification leave that record after 48 hours, and the whole record is deleted after 30 days, by a routine that runs every day. When that record exists and you tap a button that leads to the store, the identifier of that visit travels inside the link, and section 3 tells what happens to it.
Privacy.s2Title: 2. How We Use Your Data (Anonymized Telemetry)
Privacy.s2Item1: Service Operation: We use your location strictly to calculate the direction vector and proximity to cultural triggers, ensuring audio delivery at the correct timing.
Privacy.s2Item2: Territorial Intelligence (The B2G Standard): Geolocation and audio playback data are de-linked from your personal identity (anonymized) before being stored for flow analysis. We provide aggregated reports to Governments and Rental Companies (e.g., "How many plays occurred at monument X today") without ever exposing who the user was. In those reports we track cultural flows, not individuals.
Privacy.s3Item1: We do not sell your data. TUGGI does not trade Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with data brokers or ad networks.
Privacy.s3Item2: Beyond the case described below, we share data only with infrastructure providers strictly necessary for the app to function, such as secure cloud services (e.g., Supabase for database/authentication and Google Cloud for the Text-to-Speech engine). These partners operate under strict confidentiality agreements.
Privacy.s3Item3: The Partner Visit Identifier: On Android that identifier travels inside the Google Play link, so Google receives it when you go to install the app from the store. It is a code on our side, and it carries neither your name nor your email. On iPhone that route does not exist. There we copy the same identifier to your device's clipboard, at the moment you tap the button, for the app to read the first time it opens.
Privacy.s4Item1: We employ end-to-end encryption in transit and at rest. Access to corporate databases and the City OS dashboard is protected by Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), ensuring data isolation.
Privacy.s4Item2: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to provide the service. Anonymized telemetry data may be retained permanently for product improvement.
Privacy.s5Intro: You have full control over your data. At any time, you can request:
Privacy.s5Item1: Access, correction, or portability of your information.
Privacy.s5Item2: The revocation of GPS use consent (which will make the app's core functionality impossible).
Privacy.s5ItemO1: The permanent deletion of your account and personal data. To exercise this right, access our
Privacy.s5ItemO3: or use the native function within the app.
Privacy.s5ItemLead1: Removal of the business contact details you left in a form on this site, even if you have never had an account in the app. Write to
Privacy.s5ItemLead2: asking for removal: we close any contact cycle under way and delete your details from our business contact list. The data deletion page is only for app accounts.
Privacy.s5ItemPartner1: Removal of the data you sent in a partnership proposal, as far as it is not needed for the partnership under way. Write to
Privacy.s5ItemPartner2: telling us what you want removed. If you ask us not to contact you again, contact stops immediately. The record of acceptance of a contract already signed stays as proof of it, and a request to remove contact details does not erase that record.
Privacy.s6P1: If you have questions about this policy or the processing of your data, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) through our
Privacy.s6P3: page, by choosing the profile that describes you.
Privacy.s7Text: TUGGI does not knowingly collect data from children under 13 without parental consent. If we discover we have collected such data, we will take steps to delete it immediately.

DataDeletion.title: Data Deletion Protocol
DataDeletion.intro: You hold absolute control over your telemetry and account records. At TUGGI, we ensure that your right to be forgotten is respected across our entire infrastructure.
DataDeletion.formDesc: Enter your account email below. Our team will review your request and process the deletion within 24-48 business hours. You will receive a confirmation email once the process is complete.
DataDeletion.s1Desc: When you execute a deletion request:
DataDeletion.s1Item1: Your account profile and login credentials are permanently removed from our Auth provider.
DataDeletion.s1Item2: All device identifiers linked to your previous sessions are scrubbed from our telemetry database.
DataDeletion.s1Item3: Any anonymized flow data previously generated remains in the aggregate, but can never be re-associated with your identity.

Form.success: Request Received - We'll contact you in 48h

Security.title: Governance, Security, and Availability
Security.subtitle: A Commitment of Trust.
Security.s1Desc: TUGGI maintains its standard curation via CMS, using verified sources and artificial intelligence.
Security.s2Item1: Information Custody: TUGGI acts as the technical custodian of the platform. Every change to an audio trigger, whether made by TUGGI or a government partner, is recorded in immutable audit logs (RBAC), making it possible to track who, when, and where a narrative was altered.
Security.s3Title: 3. Reliability and Performance (For the B2C User)
Security.s3Intro: For the traveler, reliability is measured in use. With the content already downloaded, the audio starts on its own, even where there is no signal:
Security.s3Item1: Offline-First Availability: We designed TUGGI not to rely on the cloud at the moment of triggering. Once the travel package is downloaded, audio activation is local and immediate.
Security.s4Desc: Our data is hosted in world-class data centers with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We use Supabase for identity management and Google Cloud for audio processing.

Accessibility.title: Accessibility & Inclusion
Accessibility.subtitle: Commitment to Inclusion and Universal Design.
Accessibility.intro: At TUGGI Technologies, we believe that access to local culture and history should have no barriers. TUGGI was conceived under the "Audio-First" premise, transforming the discovery experience into something purely sensory and auditory, which naturally benefits users with different accessibility profiles.
Accessibility.s1Intro: We are committed to ensuring that our digital platform and mobile app follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, at Level AA.
Accessibility.s1Item1: Visual Design: We measured this site's palette against the WCAG 2.1 Level AA contrast minimum, the threshold that keeps text readable for people with low vision (audit: {a11ySiteAuditDate}). On brand colors, text and icons use the palette's dark color, and the typeface is Inter.
Accessibility.s1Item2: Navigation: Our interface is structured to be compatible with screen readers (such as VoiceOver on iOS and TalkBack on Android).
Accessibility.s2Intro: Our product is designed to be accessible to both drivers and passengers:
Accessibility.s2Item1: Audio-First Experience: We eliminate the need for visual or tactile interaction with the screen during the trip. Stories are automatically triggered via geolocation, allowing visually impaired people and those with reduced mobility to enjoy the content autonomously.
Accessibility.s2Item2: Closed Captions: For passengers with hearing impairments, TUGGI offers real-time synchronized transcription. While the audio plays, the narrative text is displayed on the screen, ensuring that no one misses the cultural context of the route.
Accessibility.s2Item3: Linguistic Accessibility: We offer multilingual support in {contentLanguages} languages, ensuring that the language barrier is not an impediment to knowledge.
Accessibility.s3Intro: Accessibility is an ongoing process. We recognize that there is always room for improvement and are ready to listen to our users.
Accessibility.s4Desc: Beyond technical accessibility, TUGGI acts as an agent of social inclusion. We democratize access to culture by decentralizing tourism. By redirecting flow from saturated areas to peripheral zones, we foster the local creative economy, giving a voice to the native historians, actors, and guides who build our narratives.
Accessibility.s3Item1: Report a Barrier: If you run into an access difficulty on our website or app, tell us which page or screen it happened on, what you were trying to do, and what you navigate with, such as a screen reader, the keyboard or zoom.
Accessibility.s3Item2: Commitment: We analyze each report with technical priority to ensure that TUGGI continues to be the cultural co-pilot for everyone, without exception.

Hero.title: Before we see, we hear.
Hero.body: Hearing is our oldest and most fundamental sense. Before we are born, we recognize the world through the sound of our mother's voice. We learn to listen before we learn to speak, read, or walk. TUGGI was born from this biological truth: the most natural way to absorb the world around us is not by staring at a screen, but by listening to it.

Freedom.title: The Freedom to Explore.
Freedom.body: Tourism has been trapped in rigid schedules, crowded buses, and language barriers. We believe exploration should be absolute freedom. You shouldn't have to wait for a tour guide or keep your eyes glued to a map app. With TUGGI, you drive, walk, or ride at your own pace. The stories find you at the exact geographical moment they matter.

Values.title: The Foundation
Values.v2Desc: Just start the route and the app takes care of the rest.
Values.v3Desc: Stories deeply connected to the physical route and narrative coherence.
Values.v5Desc: We skip the basics to deliver the hidden gems and true local knowledge.
Values.v6Desc: Designed to be consumed across different profiles and native languages.
